title: Design System: World Cup 2026 Forecasting Terminal

display.purpose: Hero page title only — Plex Mono.

data.purpose: KPI values, probabilities, scorelines — Plex Mono tabular.

shadows.name: flag-seat
shadows.purpose: Under rectangular flags only; the system is otherwise flat.

motion.name: grow-bar
motion.purpose: Probability bars grow once from the left.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one key action per view; solid cyan, near-black ink, mono.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #3AC9E0; color: #06222A; border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.55rem 1.4rem; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13.5px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #74E2F2; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #74E2F2; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: KPI Panel
components.description: Flat metric panel: mono uppercase label, large mono tabular value.

components.css: .ds-kpi { background: #11151C; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); border-radius: 6px; padding: 18px 20px 16px; transition: border-color .15s ease; } .ds-kpi:hover { border-color: rgba(58,201,224,.38); } .ds-kpi-label { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #7D8794; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-kpi-value { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 26px; font-weight: 600; color: #E6EDF3; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-kpi-delta { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; margin-top: 8px; color: #3AC9E0; }

components.name: Pipeline Chip
components.description: Static mono chip naming an ensemble model; cyan square dot.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #161B23; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10); border-radius: 4px; padding: 7px 14px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; color: #C3CDD8; } .ds-chip-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 1px; background: #3AC9E0; }

narrative.overview: A Bloomberg/trading-terminal for football. Near-black graph-paper canvas, monospace data (IBM Plex Mono) so every figure aligns into columns, IBM Plex Sans for prose. One cyan accent carries all data and interaction; one amber signal marks exactly the single champion/leader per view. Flat surfaces, a single hairline border, sharp 4-6px radii, near-square bars. No gradients, no glow, no gold-gamer chrome. Motion is fast and minimal.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black graph-paper canvas (#0A0C10) with a faint baseline grid
Monospace data (IBM Plex Mono); IBM Plex Sans only for prose
One cyan accent for data/active; one amber signal for the single champion
Flat surfaces, one hairline border, 4-6px radii, near-square bars
Tabular columns; figures align down the page

rules.name: The One-Cyan Rule
rules.body: Cyan is the only brand hue for data and interaction. New chart categories are separated by value or shape, never a third colour.

rules.name: The Single-Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber appears once per screen and means 'the leader.' A second amber element devalues it.

rules.name: The Monospace-Figure Rule
rules.body: Every number lives in IBM Plex Mono so figures align into columns — the terminal signature.

rules.name: The Flat-Grid Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat and respond to hover by brightening their hairline toward cyan — never by lifting or gaining a shadow.

dos: Do set every figure in IBM Plex Mono so columns self-align.
Do keep cyan as the only data/interaction hue; separate chart categories by value or shape.
Do reserve amber for exactly one champion/leader element per screen.
Do build flat panels with one hairline; brighten toward cyan on hover instead of shadow/lift.
Do keep muted text at #7D8794 or lighter-ink and verify >=4.5:1.
Do keep motion fast and minimal with a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.
donts: Don't reintroduce the dark-dashboard-with-gold look — no gold gradients, no gamer chrome.
Don't use Inter or Space Grotesk anywhere — the most common AI-UI pairing of 2026.
Don't add gradient-tinted cards, decorative glows, or glassmorphism.
Don't build rainbow / chart-junk visuals or spend a third saturated hue.
Don't let two elements be amber at once.
Don't uppercase a display-size mono heading — it overflows.
